what: Pre-Step-0 upgrade to simple is only mental state while Step 0b still parses the original --trivial argv
scenario_or_breakage: With /design --trivial --brainstorm, selecting Upgrade to --simple can still let Step 0b see --trivial in $ARGUMENTS and write run-params as the trivial zero-sketch tier, contradicting the operator choice
suggested_fix: Add an explicit resolved_tier override contract: Pre-Step-0 sets it, Step 0b parser must ignore the original --trivial when it is set, and structural tests should pin the override path

what: The plan says --brainstorm fires on already-planned ad-hoc Q&A, but does not change the already-planned router contract
scenario_or_breakage: The existing already-planned branch can choose ad-hoc Q&A only and exit without reaching Step 1d.5, so the promised unconditional brainstorm behavior is not implemented for that path
suggested_fix: Either remove that promised edge-case behavior or add explicit Step 0b routing for ad-hoc Q&A that materializes run-params with brainstorm_requested=true and invokes the Step 1d.5 loop before the Q&A exit

what: Runtime external failures in brainstorm proceed with fewer slots instead of following the existing per-slot fallback standard
scenario_or_breakage: A Cursor or Codex timeout after launch reduces the intended 3-agent ideation panel to 2 or 1 outputs, while the repo standard says failed external slots should fall through replacement rather than shrink panel shape
suggested_fix: On non-OK collector status, log the failure and run a Claude replacement for that brainstorm slot, writing the same output path before synthesis; only proceed with fewer outputs if the replacement also fails

what: The new test-brainstorm-prompts harness is not wired into Makefile shards or agent-lint exclusions
scenario_or_breakage: make lint either never runs the new regression harness, or agent-lint flags the skill-local Makefile-only test script and sibling md as dead or orphaned
suggested_fix: Add a Makefile .PHONY target, recipe, and exactly one test-harnesses-N shard entry; add the new .sh and .md to the existing skills/design/scripts test exclusions in agent-lint.toml

what: Public /design flag documentation is omitted for the new public --brainstorm surface
scenario_or_breakage: Consumers reading the canonical README or docs/skills argument list will not discover the flag or its --trivial mutual-exclusion behavior
suggested_fix: Update README.md and docs/skills.md argument strings and prose; consider docs/workflow-lifecycle.md if it remains a public command summary

what: The run-params schema sibling contract is not updated for brainstorm_requested
scenario_or_breakage: The script contract continues to list only partition_requested even though the writer emits a new schema field, making future maintenance and harness expectations drift
suggested_fix: Update scripts/write-run-params.md and scripts/test-write-run-params.md alongside the script and tests to document --brainstorm-requested and the emitted brainstorm_requested boolean
